distance_definition: Signed projection of vehicle COM minus registered surface center on the frozen outward unit normal, in meters.
nominal_reset: Position center + standoff * normal, upright, zero world velocity and body rates, nominal equilibrium actuator state and commands.

training_distribution_proposal.sampling: uniform, one shared state-based Direct-CTBR actor
training_distribution_proposal.perturbations: Original frozen reset perturbation envelope. Actual normal COM coordinate spans 0.96 to 1.29 m.

evaluation.case_generator: rm27_contact_rl.stage1_runner.evaluation_initials, unchanged fixed 19 cases per nominal distance
evaluation.denominator: All 57 starts, including initial rejection, timeout and safety failure. Report each 19-case stratum and the aggregate.
evaluation.qualification: Unchanged frozen full-field MuJoCo Stage1Evaluator. Each episode runs continuously from reset with the learned actor choosing all commands.
